detected_issues.description: after_commit did not check for the existence or type of session._changes and could raise on missing attributes.
detected_issues.root_cause: session._changes was used without defensive checks; could be missing or wrong type

detected_issues.description: _changes was not cleared between transactions, leaving stale or residual values.
detected_issues.root_cause: global mutable state attached to session persisted across commits

detected_issues.description: _changes attached to a global db.session which is not session-safe or thread-safe.
detected_issues.root_cause: global session attribute mutation rather than session.info or thread-local storage

detected_issues.description: Index updates lacked atomicity and could be lost or interleaved on concurrent commits.
detected_issues.root_cause: no locking or queuing for index calls; simultaneous append to shared list caused race conditions

detected_issues.description: Test coverage deficiencies allowed regressions: missing tests for leftover/missing changes and rollbacks.
detected_issues.root_cause: insufficient test cases for edge conditions

detected_issues.description: Event registration used db.session rather than Session-level binding, potentially missing event triggering for different session types.
detected_issues.root_cause: wrong choice of SQLAlchemy event target

edits: Use session.info['search_changes'] instead of attaching _changes to global session
Add defensive checks and reinitialization in _init_changes to clear stale data
Add thread lock _INDEX_LOCK and atomic_add_to_index to ensure index write atomicity
Use event.listens_for(Session, ...) for before_commit, after_commit, and after_rollback
Added Flask app fixture and database setup/teardown
Added tests for missing/leftover changes and rollback behavior
Test concurrent updates and transaction isolation using multiple threads
Ensured reproducible SQLite config and check_same_thread=False
